text:
maria: quick sync: we need rollout plan for proto-first routing. ops wants console suggestions for failures.
chris: clarify: UI suggestions or routing policy changes automated?
sasha: both. console should show per-route protocol split, error rate per protocol, and a suggested fallback weight.
maria: ops asked: 'if grpc 5xx > 0.5% over 3m, recommend reduce grpc by 20%'.
todd: recommended only. one-click canary rollback is fine, auto-act is dangerous.
jamal: telemetry: we can emit per-protocol 5xx and p95. will add translation_mismatch counter; must tag by tenant+route.
chris: tenant tagging increases cardinality. suggest deterministic 10% sampling for tenant-level metrics.
sasha: sampling + stable hash works; console uses sampled numbers for suggestions.
maria: where should fallback decide: at edge proxy or central controlplane?
todd: controlplane for policy + visibility. edge keeps last-known weights and local static fallback when controlplane unreachable.
chris: controlplane adds a dependency. design for fail-open and TTL on configs.
sasha: parity matters: do we transcode or offer dual endpoints?
todd: prefer proto for internal traffic. provide a lightweight json bridge for external clients; avoid full-time transcoding.
chris: add a parity test in canaries: compare N requests proto vs json; if mismatch rate > threshold roll back.
jamal: will add translation_mismatch metric and sample mismatches (sanitized) for debugging.
sasha: UI mock: rollout modal shows split, p95/5xx, mismatch rate, actions: inc/dec weight, pause canary, add note.
maria: permissions: only owners or SRE can apply suggestions; audit log entry for every weight change.
chris: reuse deploy ACLs and event logging.
todd: agreement? proto-first router + controlplane suggestions + edge fallback + parity checks + mismatch telemetry.
sasha: +1. i'll attach runbook link to the modal.
jamal: @deploy-bot create canary job: proto-fronting-parity-checker
deploy-bot: Created proto-fronting-parity-checker (manual). metrics: p95 by protocol, 5xx, translation_mismatch_rate.
maria: thanks. owners: chris (telemetry), jamal (mismatch metric), sasha (UI), todd (edge config). sync tomorrow 10:00.
